steps.do: Greet the customer and confirm they want a personal card recommendation, for example the card with the highest cash back. Do not verify identity: no customer records are read or changed.
steps.quote: You earn 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases.

steps.do: Before comparing cards, ask for each info item the customer has not given: personal or business use, main spending categories and any that another card already covers, and whether they will accept an annual fee. Do not verify identity, because no customer records are read.
steps.quote: Each credit card has its own bonus categories with higher reward rates.

steps.do: Ask for the yearly fee budget and the expected monthly spend before recommending anything. These decide whether the Platinum rebate makes its fee acceptable.
steps.if: the customer may accept an annual fee and has not already given a fee budget and monthly spend
steps.quote: Earn a $150.00 rebate on your annual fee by meeting a monthly spend threshold of $7500.00.

steps.do: Ask whether the customer has an active Rho-Bank+ subscription, their approximate credit score, and whether they hold a Diamond Elite invitation. Ask before recommending, because customers often do not volunteer these facts.
steps.if: the customer has not already said these
steps.quote: Rho‑Bank+ premium subscription required: Yes

steps.do: Call get_current_time to see which promotion windows are open, such as the Platinum first-year fee waiver (2024-06-01 to 2024-12-31) or the Bronze 0% APR window (2025-09-01 through 2026-02-28). Mention only promotions whose window includes today.
steps.if: a fee-waiver promotion would affect the comparison, or the agent intends to mention any promotion
steps.quote: Apply during the promo window and, if approved, your first year annual fee is $0.00 instead of $200.00.

steps.do: Remove cards the customer cannot get. Gold Rewards needs Rho-Bank+ and a score of at least 720. Platinum needs 750. Silver needs 680. Crypto-Cash Back needs 660. Bronze needs 640. EcoCard has no score minimum. Diamond Elite is by invitation only (score about 780 or higher).
steps.quote: Minimum credit score: $680

steps.do: Compare all personal cards: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond Elite, Crypto-Cash Back and EcoCard. Use each card's earn rate on the customer's actual spending, its effective annual fee (fee minus any rebate) and its eligibility. Earn rates: Bronze 1.0%; Silver 4.0% on travel/software and 1.0% otherwise; Gold 2.5%; Crypto-Cash Back 2.0%; Platinum 10.0%; Diamond Elite 5.0%; EcoCard 5 points/$ on green and 1 point/$ otherwise ($0.01 per point). Platinum's $200.00 fee nets to $50 if at least $7500.00 is spent in every month. Do not count bonus categories already covered by another card, such as travel paid by a corporate card. Drop ineligible cards and cards whose fee the customer will not accept, then pick the highest earn rate left.
steps.quote: Purchases in non-bonus categories earn the card’s default rate.

steps.do: Apply the customer's fee preference. Annual fees: Bronze $0.00, Silver $0.00, Gold $0.00, EcoCard $50.00, Crypto-Cash Back $75.00, Platinum $200.00, Diamond Elite $495.00. If the customer refuses annual fees, keep only the eligible $0.00 cards. Consider a fee card only if the customer accepts fees or no eligible fee-free card remains.
steps.quote: Consider your net rewards after the $200.00 annual fee when planning large purchases.

steps.do: Recommend the Gold Rewards Card and explain it: 2.5% cash back on all purchases, $0.00 annual fee, Rho-Bank+ required, minimum score 720, 0% foreign transaction fee.
steps.if: the customer has Rho-Bank+ and a score of at least 720, and wants no annual fee (or Gold gives the highest net return within their fee budget)
steps.quote: Cash back on all purchases: 2.5%

steps.do: Recommend the Silver Rewards Card if a meaningful share of the customer's own spending is travel or software and their score is at least 680. Otherwise explain that both Silver and Bronze earn 1.0% on everyday spending, and recommend Bronze if the score is below 680.
steps.if: Gold is not eligible (no Rho-Bank+ or score below 720) and the customer wants no annual fee
steps.quote: You earn 1.0% cash back on eligible purchases.

steps.do: Recommend exactly one card: the Platinum Rewards Card. Explain 10.0% cash back, the $200.00 annual fee, the $150.00 rebate when the threshold is met in all 12 monthly windows, and the minimum credit score of $750.
steps.if: expected monthly spend >= $7500.00, $200.00 - $150.00 is within the customer's fee budget, and the score is at least 750
steps.quote: A single month below the threshold disqualifies you from receiving the rebate for that entire cardmember year; there is no partial or prorated rebate.

steps.do: Recommend the eligible fee card with the highest net cash back on the customer's spending, and state its fee clearly. Platinum: 10% for $200.00, with a $150.00 rebate only if $7500.00 is spent in every month. Diamond Elite: 5% for $495.00, invitation only. Crypto-Cash Back: 2% for $75.00. EcoCard: $50.00.
steps.if: the customer accepts an annual fee (the card's fee fits their budget) but recommend_one does not apply, or no eligible fee-free card exists
steps.quote: You earn 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases.

steps.do: Recommend the highest-earning eligible card that fits the budget: Gold at 2.5% if the customer has Rho-Bank+, otherwise the next highest flat rate. If no card fits, say so.
steps.if: Platinum's effective fee exceeds the customer's budget
steps.quote: Rho‑Bank+ premium subscription required: Yes

steps.do: Present the card chosen in the branch steps above and explain why: its earn rate, its annual fee and any requirement such as Rho-Bank+. Give only public product terms. If the customer rejects every card that fits, say so and do not push.
steps.quote: Cash back on all purchases: 2.5%

steps.do: Tell the customer plainly that no card meets their requirements. Do not push an ineligible card or one they rejected, and end politely if they choose to go elsewhere.
steps.if: no eligible card meets the customer's stated requirements
steps.quote: Membership is by invitation only (Yes).

steps.do: The customer applies for the recommended card with their own apply_for_credit_card tool. The agent does not apply for them, and need not walk them through it unless asked.
